description: Maps of solar resource potential in Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. This dataset includes daily averages of solar irradiance on tilted surfaces for all of Canada based on the period of 1998 - 2020. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are Énergie solaire, Chauffage solaire, Solar energy, Solar heating. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-02-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
